About

Experience, expertise,
and compassionate care

A/Prof David Littlejohn is one of Australia's most experienced and respected oncoplastic breast surgeons, with over 26 years of subspecialist practice spanning Sydney and regional New South Wales. Trained at the Prince of Wales Hospital, Randwick, he went on to refine his oncoplastic skills in the United Kingdom under Mr Rainsbury — a founding pioneer of the discipline — before returning to Australia in 2000 to build a practice that has since become a benchmark for the field.

Consulting across Sydney and at the Wagga Wagga Specialist Medical Centre, A/Prof Littlejohn is renowned for his technical precision and patient-centred approach. His practice is among the few in Australia to offer neoadjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy — treating the cancer first to reduce tumour size before surgery — resulting in significantly better cosmetic and surgical outcomes for patients.

A leader in education and research, A/Prof Littlejohn is a founding member of Breast Surgeons NSW and BreastSurgANZ, and served as past Vice President of the Breast Surgical Society of Australia and New Zealand. He pioneered oncoplastic cadaveric surgical courses across Australia and New Zealand, convening the inaugural Level 2 Cadaver workshop in Brisbane in 2014. He is a sought-after speaker at national and international conferences, and a lecturer for the Sydney University Graduate Certificate in Breast Cancer Surgery.

Beyond breast surgery, A/Prof Littlejohn holds specialist expertise in endocrine and laparoscopic surgery. As a member of the International Society of Endocrine Surgeons, he has published on minimally invasive parathyroid surgery and the application of 4DCT imaging, and carries extensive experience in the diagnosis and management of breast implant-related complications.

His clinic has also been recognised for its success in engaging Aboriginal patients at earlier stages of breast cancer presentation — a reflection of his commitment to equitable, accessible care across the communities he serves.

Services

How Dr Littlejohn
can help you

01

Breast & Oncoplastic Surgery

Advanced oncoplastic breast cancer surgery including flap-based reconstructions. One of the few centres offering neoadjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy to shrink tumours first, delivering superior cosmetic outcomes for patients.

02

Endocrine Surgery

Specialist surgical care for conditions of the thyroid, parathyroid, and adrenal glands. A/Prof Littlejohn is a member of the Australian and New Zealand Endocrine Surgeons and has particular expertise in minimally invasive parathyroid surgery, thyroid nodule management, and 4DCT-guided procedures.

03

Laparoscopic Surgery

Minimally invasive surgery using small incisions and precision instruments — offering patients significantly less pain, faster recovery, and minimal scarring compared to traditional open techniques. A/Prof Littlejohn applies laparoscopic approaches across a broad range of abdominal and endocrine procedures.

04

General Surgery

A comprehensive range of general surgical services including colonoscopy and gastroscopy for diagnosis and treatment of bowel and digestive conditions, surgical management of skin cancers and suspicious lesions — including melanoma — and hernia repair using both open and laparoscopic techniques.

Approach

Dedication to quality
& service

A seamless progression from diagnosis to treatment and reconstruction.
01

Listen First

Every consultation begins with truly hearing the patient — their symptoms, their concerns, and their goals. A correct diagnosis follows from careful listening.

02

Evidence-Based Practice

Treatment recommendations are grounded in the best available clinical evidence, combined with sound clinical judgement and individual patient context.

03

Seamless, Coordinated Care

A/Prof Littlejohn works with a dedicated multidisciplinary team to ensure a seamless progression from diagnosis through to treatment and reconstruction — with continuity and quality at every stage.
